item.title: Why won’t Newsom tax billionaires?
item.description: Not only are Californians struggling to make ends meet, they also have to contend with a governor who cares more about billionaires and his own presidential aspirations.

item.title: The War intervention: AI, data centers, and the environment
item.description: This increasingly inextricable partnership between AI and the war economy is throwing us into a fast track of climate and environmental chaos that threatens us all.

item.title: Faith activists are praying with their feet in Minneapolis
item.description: I have no doubt that the disciplined, caring and prayerful response of the people to ICE will win.

item.title: Trump attacked Ilhan Omar hours before she was assaulted at Minnesota town hall
item.description: The attack followed days of escalating rhetoric and public targeting by the president and his allies.
